question: What identity is invoked through the repeated address to the increaser of all good fortune?
premises: The compound names an increaser of all good fortune
The same epithet is repeated four times
inference: The repeated invocation emphasizes and sanctifies the increaser of all good fortune.
plain_english: O increaser of all good fortune, O increaser of all good fortune, O increaser of all good fortune, O increaser of all good fortune!
